# ADR-3030: A03: Template injection render for page family 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Server-side template injection yields RCE.

## Decision

Servers SHALL NOT enable a template injection render for page family 6 (A03-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Logic-less templates or sandboxed engines only.
